庄拓出现（庄拓出现（第22页）他没再给孟婵玥开口的机会，转头对着旁边彻底惊呆在原地的于知晚和于伯远微微颔首，语气带着歉意：“我有几句话要同三公主说，二位暂且失陪了。”话音刚落，他直接伸手，稳稳攥住了孟婵玥的手腕。周围的人连反应的时间都没有，就呆呆地看着庄拓就那么牵着孟婵玥，往梅林深处走去。落梅顺着他们走过的路径簌簌往下掉，把身后的错愕、探究、窃窃私语，全都隔在了那片粉白的花影之后。孟婵玥被庄拓拽着走了好远，直到听不到身后半分声响，才猛地停住脚步，她脸上又恨又怒，直接拔下发髻上的黑木簪朝他刺去。“庄拓，你去死！”庄拓很轻松地捏住孟婵玥的手腕，单手将她压在一棵梅花树上。“三公主，婵玥，我以后就这么喊你。”“这段时间我不能去观星学宫，见不到你之后我才知道自己有多么想你。”“我也想着怎么杀了你！”孟婵玥挣扎不开，恨恨地看着他。见孟婵玥如此，他用另一只手捂住了她的嘴巴，然后在她杀人的目光中继续说道：“我如今已明白自己的心意，我决定娶你为妻。”“呜呜呜……”孟婵玥听到庄拓故作深情的话，只觉得荒诞无比，她使劲摇头表示拒绝。“我会请求陛下赐婚，你耐心在观星学宫备嫁。”庄拓说完，笑着松开孟婵玥。“去死！”孟婵玥心头大怒，手里的黑木簪舞得密不透风。庄拓处处让着她，时不时夸奖两句，气得孟婵玥想要呕血。她自知不是庄拓的对手，也不敢运转金色液体，只能握着黑木簪乱挥一气。“好了，该说的话都说完了，你有什么想要的，尽管跟鸣秀说，我都会替你寻来！”庄拓见孟婵玥一直拿着黑木簪刺自己，再次抓住她的手，将她抱入怀中。“庄拓，我死都不会嫁给你！”“你杀了涂山氏一族，杀了我母妃，我们之间不死不休！”孟婵玥眼中的恨意宛如实质，刺的庄拓心尖颤抖。他看着她，眼底快速闪过一丝痛意。他直接点了孟婵玥的哑穴，将她紧紧搂住。“你不能恨我！我不准！”“你只能属于我！”孟婵玥被他抱在怀里，口不能言，双眼恨得溢出血色。两人僵持了一会儿，一道黑影闪了进来。“主人，陛下急召。”守山看着梅林中的两人，目光快速扫过孟婵玥充满恨意的双眼，垂下眼眸。“婵玥，不要恨我！”庄拓在孟婵玥的眉间轻轻落下一吻，解开她的哑穴，松开她，转身离开。孟婵玥看到他离开，恨得一拳打在一旁的梅花树上，眼底满是慌乱。可恨，她有仇报不了，还要被仇人强娶，她该如何自救？

> Chapter 58 Zhuang Tuo appears (page 1)
Zhuang Tuo appeared (Zhuang Tuo appeared (page 22)) He didn't give Meng Chanyue another chance to speak. He turned to Yu Zhiwan and Yu Boyuan who were completely stunned on the spot and nodded slightly with an apologetic tone: "I have a few words to say to the third princess. I'll excuse you two for now." As soon as he finished speaking, he reached out directly and firmly grasped Meng Chanyue's wrist. People around him didn't even have time to react. Yes, I just watched blankly as Zhuang Tuo held Meng Chanyue's hand and walked towards the depths of the plum forest. The plum blossoms fell along the path they walked, hiding the surprise, inquiry and whispers behind them behind the pink flowers. Meng Chanyue was dragged away by Zhuang Tuo for a long distance, and she stopped abruptly until she couldn't hear any sound behind her. She pulled the pluck down with hatred and anger on her face. The black wood hairpin in her bun stabbed at him. "Zhuang Tuo, go to hell!" Zhuang Tuo easily grabbed Meng Chanyue's wrist and pressed her against a plum blossom tree with one hand. "Third Princess, Chanyue, I'm going to kill you." That's what I called you later." "I can't go to Star Gazing Academy during this period. I didn't know how much I missed you until I couldn't see you." "I also thought about how to kill you!" Meng Chanyue struggled. , looked at him hatefully. Seeing Meng Chanyue like this, he covered her mouth with his other hand, and then continued in her murderous eyes: "I now understand my intention, and I have decided to marry you." "Uuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuu" When Meng Chanyue heard Zhuang Tuo's affectionate words, she thought it was ridiculous, and she shook her head vigorously to express her rejection, "I will ask your majesty to grant a marriage, please be patient. Guanxing Academy is getting married." After Zhuang Tuo finished speaking, he let go of Meng Chanyue. "Go to hell!" Meng Chanyue was furious, and the black wood hairpin in her hand danced tightly. Zhuang Tuo gave in to her at every turn and praised her from time to time. Meng Chanyue was so angry that she wanted to vomit blood. She knew she was no match for Zhuang Tuo, and she didn't dare to use the golden liquid, so she could only hold the black wood hairpin and wave it wildly. "Okay, I've said all I need to say. If you want anything, just tell Mingxiu and I will find it for you!" Seeing Meng Chanyue stabbing herself with the black wood hairpin, Zhuang Tuo grabbed her hand again and held her in his arms. "Zhuang Tuo, I will never marry you!" "You killed the Tushan clan and my mother-in-law, and we will fight until death!" The hatred in Meng Chanyue's eyes was so real that it made Zhuang Tuo's heart tremble. He looked at her with a flash of pain. He directly touched Meng Chanyue's mute point and hugged her tightly. "You can't hate me! I won't allow it!" "You can only belong to me!" Meng Chanyue was held in his arms, unable to speak, and her eyes were filled with hatred. The two were in a stalemate for a while, and a black shadow flashed in. "Master, Your Majesty is calling." His eyes quickly glanced at Meng Chanyue's eyes full of hatred, and he lowered his eyes. "Chanyue, don't hate me!" Zhuang Tuo gently kissed Meng Chanyue's eyebrows, untied her cunt, and let go of her. Turning around and leaving. When Meng Chanyue saw him leaving, she punched the plum blossom tree nearby, her eyes full of panic. How could she save herself if she couldn't avenge her and was forced to marry by her enemy?
